anomalies.observed: All VDD pins of the FCC STM32H753VITx (pins 11, 27, 50, 75, 100) are left unconnected in the netlist.
anomalies.expected: The VDD pins must be connected to the 3.3V rail, as the specification states that 3V3 feeds both MCUs.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The FCC MCU receives no power and will not operate, rendering the flight control computer completely non-functional.

anomalies.observed: The PCA9685PW address pin A0 (pin 1) is tied to the +3.3V rail, while all other address pins (A1–A5) are tied to GND.
anomalies.expected: To achieve the specified I2C address 0x40, A0 must be tied to GND (all address pins low).

evidence.quote: PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40

anomalies.impact: The PCA9685 responds at I2C address 0x41 instead of 0x40, so the FCC firmware will fail to communicate with the PWM/servo driver.

anomalies.observed: The 25 MHz HSE crystal HSE2 is connected between FCC2 pins PE6 (pin 5) and PE7 (pin 37) instead of the dedicated oscillator pins PH0 (pin 12) and PH1 (pin 13).
anomalies.expected: The HSE crystal must be connected to the STM32H753 HSE oscillator pins PH0 and PH1.

anomalies.impact: The FCC MCU has no external clock source and will not start, making the board completely inoperable.
